description: Look up one WALLET's record across every token DEFADE has scanned: whether it is a repeat offender, which tokens it was seen on and in what role (bundler, sniper, insider, fresh wallet), the tokens it deployed and how many rugged, and its bundling history. The wallet-first tool: every other tool takes a token and reports on the wallets around it, this one takes a wallet the user names (a deployer, a big holder, a wallet a module flagged) and says what it has done elsewhere. Read from DEFADE's own records, so a wallet no scan has met reads UNKNOWN, which is not a clean bill. Not for a token's holders or links (get_holders, get_wallet_links), nor for what a token's creator did with this token (get_dev_tracker). Arguments: wallet and chain; one API unit, on a plan that includes the deep-analysis modules.

chain.description: Which chain's record to read: solana, ethereum, base, bsc, robinhood, arc, hyperevm, monad, elysium. Defaults to solana; required for a 0x wallet, which exists on every EVM chain.

wallet.description: The wallet address to look up, never a token contract. Solana: a base58 address, 32-44 characters. EVM: 0x followed by 40 hex characters; set chain to the EVM chain whose record you want, as each chain keeps its own.

name: get_wallet_reputation

bundler.description: Its record in the bundler registry: launches it bundled, and with which tools.

chain.description: The chain whose record this is.

deployer.description: Tokens this wallet deployed that DEFADE has on record, with how many rugged.

labels.description: The roles scans filed it under (bundle, sniper, insider, fresh …), with labelCounts and labelGlossary saying what each means.

operators.description: Funding bands this wallet ran on scanned tokens, with how many rugged.

roles.description: The labels the lookup page prints: Sniper, Bundler, a named tool's bundler, deployer.

sightings.description: The tokens it was seen on, rugged first: mint, symbol, labels, maxRugScore, rugOutcome.

tier.description: REPEAT_OFFENDER (an operator role on rugged tokens, again and again), RUG_ASSOCIATED (seen on at least one rugged token), OBSERVED (seen by scans, no rug) or UNKNOWN (no scan has seen it as a holder; deployer, bundler and operators can still name a serial deployer or a known bundler).

tokensSeen.description: Tokens DEFADE scans have seen this wallet on; rugsSeen and operatorRugsSeen count the rugged ones.

title: Wallet reputation
